semantic_findings.assessment: Current official 2015 PDF explicitly establishes Swedish citizenship. Prior A records Swedish and British using a model-mediated Wikipedia extract. Neither single nationality mention nor an unverified old model return resolves completeness. The new Swedish claim is supported, but unqualified unchanged semantic completeness cannot be claimed. No new source was fetched to repair or adjudicate the archived result.

25 nationality cells cite secondary Wikipedia year pages; the three 2015 cells cite the official announcement. All are literal archived support, not inferred from birthplaces. Source quality and exhaustiveness are not guaranteed by membership.

The final self-check retains 19 stalled_search signals plus one failed_fetch signal. Many searches were followed by empty discovery records despite the completed table. Do not equate zero issues with zero signals or perfect discovery bookkeeping.

Contiguous quotes include whitespace and neighboring columns. Complete affiliations are supported by their full aligned source context, but an isolated flattened quote may be awkward to read. No stitched or silently normalized quotation is substituted.
